Finding: "Set new password" screen is missing — the reset flow ends at "Recovery link dispatched".
Suggested decision: Design a Set New Password screen + success state (all 4 breakpoints).

Finding: OTP error states missing (wrong code, expired code, too many attempts).
Where does the phone number come from? OTP says "We sent a code to +20 10 9876 5432", but Register has no phone field.
Suggested decision: Either add a phone field to Register, or verify email first and phone later. SRS FR-1.5 allows email or SMS.

Finding: Password rule differs by breakpoint: "8+ chars" (native), "Min. 8 characters" (mobile web), "at least 8 characters with 1 number" (desktop), "8 letters & numbers with at least one symbol" (Arabic tablet).
Suggested decision: Pick one rule and use identical copy in EN/AR.

Finding: Tablet Register has no Full Name field and no Apple button; Tablet Login has both SSO buttons.

Error-state desktop screens use a different header/footer (nav "Cottages & Camps · Freedive & Scuba · Bedouin Treks · Environmental Charter · HOST A REEF CHALET · Sign In") and the brand written "ذهب" (gold) instead of "دهب" (Dahab).
Suggested decision: Use the standard shell; fix Arabic spelling.

Finding: Wrong-credentials native copy says "The password entered is incorrect" → reveals the account exists.
Lockout policy not defined (attempt count, duration).
OTP timer/validity differs (04:32 desktop, 0:51/0:27/0:44 resend on others; reset says 15 min).
Suggested decision: Define: registration code validity, reset link validity, resend cooldown.

Finding: Native app screens show the web "INSTALL" PWA banner (Edit Profile, OTP native).
Tablet OTP copy is written for hosts ("Two-Step Host Security", "Protecting bedouin dive trips…").
Edit Profile collects much more than FR-1.3 (passport/national ID, emergency contact, dive certifications, permits, reef pledge, profile completeness).
Suggested decision: Decide MVP scope; if kept, update SRS and treat IDs as sensitive data (NFR-9).

Finding: Log out exists only on native; no web avatar/account menu is designed.
Suggested decision: Design the logged-in header menu (Profile, Bookings, Saved, Log out).

Finding: "Quick fill" chips on Forgot Password show stored emails/phones — privacy risk on shared devices.
Suggested decision: Only show values from this device, or remove.

Finding: "Contact Bedouin Support" target is undefined.
Suggested decision: Define support channel (WhatsApp Business number / help centre).

Finding: Three different filter-panel designs on Native and Mobile Web, two on Tablet, one on Desktop — with different groups and price ranges.
Suggested decision: Pick one filter model (groups, ranges, labels) and one layout per breakpoint; delete the rest in Figma.

Finding: Mobile Web filter variant B (16:7360) is almost identical to variant A but its text isn't live text layers (not editable/readable in Figma); Tablet variant A (16:8645) has overlapping garbled text next to "Reef Guardian Certified".
Suggested decision: Keep one clean variant per breakpoint.

Finding: Live sea conditions, "Tide & wind sync (Optimal)" dates, "Coral Index", wind per zone — no data provider in SRS §5.3.
Suggested decision: Choose a marine-weather API or admin-entered values; or drop for MVP.

Finding: The empty-results state lives in Discovery Home but is really a Search Results state.
Suggested decision: Treat it as shared "No results" pattern for module 03.

Finding: Filter panel on Home duplicates the Search Results filter (module 03) with different groups.
Suggested decision: One shared filter component for Home and Search.

Finding: Native Default frame shows the web PWA "INSTALL" banner.
Guest selector label "2 Guests · Permit OK" — "Permit OK" meaning undefined.
Counts disagree across breakpoints (42 / 38 / 24 stays; 18 in "See all").
Host tags like "Women-Led Sinai Collective", "Tribal Accord" need a data field on the listing/provider.
Suggested decision: Add to listing attributes (Provider module) or drop.

Finding: Activity Search has no Filter-panel state and no empty state.
Sort options differ (Recommended / Top Rated / Reef Proximity / Safety & Eco-Charter Verified) and SRS asks for rating, price, distance, popularity.
Suggested decision: Agree one sort list for stays and one for activities.

Finding: Page sizes differ (6 / 4 / 3 cards, "Load 12 / 10 more").
Price ranges differ between Home filter (800–6,000+) and Search filter (600–8,000+).
"Near me" / GPS (SRS §5.2) not designed on map or results.
Suggested decision: Add "Use my location" to map and distance sort.

Finding: Map style "Eco-Reef" and overlays (Protected Coral Barrier, No Anchoring zones) need custom geo data.
"Instant Reserve / Instant Book" implies instant confirmation — SRS FR-15.2 lets providers confirm bookings.
Suggested decision: Define booking confirmation mode (instant vs request) per listing.

Finding: "Sites" in "Map / Sites" toggle (activities) is undefined.
Mobile Web pin card shows total for 6 nights; other breakpoints show per-night.
Suggested decision: Choose one (recommend per-night + total when dates set).

Finding: Emergency numbers disagree: Chamber "+20 69 364 0530" vs "+20 (0)69 364 0536" (tablet article); Tourist Police "126" vs "069 364 0180"; Hospital "+20 69 364 0210" vs "+20 69 3640106" (activity page).
Suggested decision: Verify real numbers with local authorities; single admin setting.

Finding: Zone codes/labels differ: "Zone 01" (desktop), "ZONE 04 • NORTH SINAI" (tablet), "Zone B" (POI mobile); "Ras Mohammed National Park rules" on native POI (wrong park).
Suggested decision: Fix copy; zone code is a CMS field.

Finding: "Save to Itinerary" (POI) — itinerary is the AI Trip Planner (FR-9, Phase 2).
Suggested decision: For MVP map it to Favourites (FR-7.1) or remove.

Finding: Arabic versions of these pages are not designed (only Arabic sub-headings).
Suggested decision: Add at least one RTL specimen (zone or article).

Finding: Audio narration "Listen to Article" (native) is not in the SRS.
Suggested decision: Phase 2 candidate; remove from MVP or add requirement (TTS/recorded audio).

Finding: "Live Sensor" conditions on POI (tablet) — no data source.
Author differs per breakpoint for the same article (Dahab Local Stewards / Salama Al-Jabali / Tarek Mansour / Salem Al-Mezeina).
Articles list/index page ("Read all stories", "Browse All", "View All Guides") is not designed.
Suggested decision: Design a Stories/Guides index with category filters.

Finding: Zones index / "Dahab Zones Map" landing page not designed (nav link exists).
Suggested decision: Design, or point the nav link to Map View with a zones layer.

Finding: Messaging buttons (Chat with Instructor, In-App Chat, Contact Host, WhatsApp host) — in-app messaging is FR-8.1 Phase 2.
Suggested decision: MVP: WhatsApp deep link only (or hide); in-app chat in Phase 2. Also confirm whether exposing hosts' phone numbers before booking is allowed.

Finding: Host responses to reviews are shown — FR-6.3 is Later.
Suggested decision: Hide in MVP or pull FR-6.3 into MVP.

Finding: Activity price inconsistent: EGP 1,650 on detail/search, EGP 2,400 in Session Picker (module 07); totals EGP 1,850 (desktop) vs 1,700 (tablet).
Suggested decision: Single source price; fees defined once.

Finding: Cancellation window inconsistent: Property 5 days (most) vs "48 hours" (mobile web room selector); Activity 48 h (desktop) vs 24 h (tablet).
Suggested decision: Policy comes from the listing — fix copy.

Finding: Guide names inconsistent: Tablet shows "Salem Muzayna — AIDA Master Instructor" and review text "Guide: Youssef Barakat"; native says "9 Yrs"; desktop "12 Years". Host name "Sheikh Salama" vs "Sheikh Salem Tarabin" (tablet room selector).
Suggested decision: Data from provider profile; fix Figma copy.

Finding: Activity lightbox "Download RAW" of marketing photos.
Suggested decision: Remove, or restrict to guests' own session media after the activity.

Finding: Review counts differ (67 vs 142 vs 218 for the same lodge; 86 vs 142 for the activity).
Duplicate frame Activity Detail — Reviews Expanded (Desktop) (42:2626 and 42:3292).
"You won't be charged yet • Direct host confirmation" implies request-to-book; "Instant Reserve" elsewhere implies instant.
Unavailable-tier / sold-out-date state on the property page not designed.
Suggested decision: Add "Not available for your dates" state.

Finding: C-Card upload & medical clearance — storage of certificates/medical info (sensitive).
Step 2 "Guest Details & Accords" + payment is not in the new Figma — required for FR-3.2 / FR-5.1 (High, MVP).
Suggested decision: Design Step 2 (all 4 breakpoints) incl. payment errors.

Finding: Fee lines differ by breakpoint although the total is always EGP 11,473: Desktop 9,600 + 480 (5% fund) + 350 + 1,043 (10% tax) = 11,473 ✓; Tablet selector lists 520 + 310 + "14% tax" (10,430 × 1.14 would be 11,890, not 11,473); Mobile Web shows a single "EGP 830" levy; Tablet confirmation uses 8,800 for 4 nights (EGP 2,200/night) + 920 + 640 + 1,113; Property page shows "Total before taxes 10,350" with other fees.
Suggested decision: Define one fee/tax model (names, % vs fixed, taxable base) — needs finance/legal input (SRS §7.1 VAT) — and use it on every breakpoint.

Finding: Cancellation window differs: 5 days (desktop/tablet/native) vs 48 hours (mobile web).
Check-out time differs: 11:00 AM vs 11:30 AM.
Mobile Web calendar shows October 2024 and weekdays "Wed/Sun" for Oct 16/20 (other breakpoints Thu/Mon 2025).
Tablet selector shows host "Sheikh Salem Tarabin"; elsewhere "Sheikh Salama". Review count 142/218 vs 67.
Activity bookings appear in My Bookings (past list) but there is no activity-specific booking detail/cancel design.
Refundability of third-party fees (EEAA permit, eco tax) after cancellation is undefined.
Modify rules (allowed until when? fee?) undefined.
Desktop Cancel dialog is rendered behind the page footer (title and total cut off) — layout bug in Figma.
Refund destination shown as Visa (desktop) vs Apple Pay (native) for the same booking.
Suggested decision: Copy fix — always the original payment method.

Finding: Cancel dialog says "Half-Board Bedouin Dining Included"; everywhere else breakfast only.
"Request Host Override" (bespoke dates) and "Impact" card are not in the SRS.
Past items in My Bookings have Book Again but no Leave a Review button (module 08 depends on it).
Suggested decision: Add "Leave a Review" to completed bookings.

Finding: My Bookings uses a different brand lockup ("DAHAB SANCTUARY & SEA") from the rest of the app ("DAHAB • دهب RESERVATIONS • TOURING • TRIPS").
"Approx. $240 USD" conversion shown — multi-currency is FR-20.3 (Later).
Multi-room booking ("2 Rooms" appears in search) — selector supports one tier/unit only.
Suggested decision: Decide MVP: one unit per booking.

Finding: Per-person price differs: EGP 1,650 (search, detail) vs EGP 2,400 (session picker, notifications).

Suggested decision: Session times come from provider schedule; fix Figma copy.

Finding: Add-on prices differ: detail bi-fins +250, wetsuit +200, goggles +100 vs picker bi-fins +350, wetsuit +250, mask +150.
Checkout step for activities not designed.
Activity cancel / reschedule screens not designed (FR-4.3).
Suggested decision: Reuse Cancel & Modify patterns from module 06.

Finding: Prerequisite confirmation (checkbox / upload) not part of the picker.
Remaining spots shown on detail vs picker differ for the same slot (2/3/4 vs 2/4/3).
Rating/review count differs (86 vs 184 divers).

Step naming differs: picker shows 2 steps ("Session & Gear → Review & Checkout"; sold-out state: "Bedouin Briefing & Payment — Permits, Medical Waiver & Confirmation"), confirmation shows 3 ("Session & Gear → Checkout → Confirmed").
Lead guide differs: picker/sold-out name Captain Zaki Mansour (and "Tarek"), confirmation and detail page name Youssef Ben-Ammar.
Suggested decision: Guide assigned per session from the provider's staff; fix Figma copy.

Finding: Cancellation window differs inside this module: 48 h (picker) vs 24 h (sold-out state).
Ratio differs: "Max 4 Divers per Instructor" (picker) vs "1:2 safety pairing" (detail, notifications).
Suggested decision: Define capacity model (per instructor vs per buoy line).

Finding: Gear sizes chosen in the picker (wetsuit L / M) differ from the confirmation (M / S).
Activities are "Instant confirmation" here, while stays say "Direct host confirmation".
Suggested decision: Confirm the confirmation mode per listing type.

Finding: Review photo upload is designed but FR-6.2 is Later.
Suggested decision: Hide for MVP or pull FR-6.2 into MVP.

Finding: Wishlist collections & group sharing is designed but not in the SRS.
Suggested decision: Phase 2 candidate; remove from MVP screens.

Finding: Review categories on "Leave a Review" (Hospitality, Cleanliness & Eco-Living, Authenticity, Location & Access, Value & Ethical Accord) ≠ categories on Reviews Expanded (Reef Quality & Cleanliness, Eco-Living & Solar, Bedouin Hospitality, Listing Accuracy, Coordination & Logistics, Value for Conservation).
Suggested decision: Define one category list per listing type (stay vs activity).

Finding: Leave a Review for activities not designed (activity categories: Instructor Safety, Rig Stability, Equalization Coaching…).
Favourites include POIs ("The Bells Drop-off", "Cultural POIs") — SRS FR-7.1 covers properties/activities only.
Moderation before publishing — not specified for MVP.
Undo after removing a favourite not designed.
Reviews are "published following host moderation within 24h" — letting the host moderate reviews of their own property is a conflict of interest; SRS puts moderation with the admin (FR-17.3, Later).
Empty-state header still shows a heart badge "3" while 0 items are saved.
One trending-card image in the empty state is a screenshot of another UI ("Your Wishlist is Empty").
Photo size limit differs: 10 MB (review) vs 4 MB (profile photo, module 01).
"Split deposits with fellow travelers" and "Export Itinerary PDF" imply group payments/itineraries — not in the SRS.
Native tab bar here has 5 tabs (Explore · Saved · Bookings · Updates · Profile), other modules have 4 (no Updates). The native Notification screen is also branded "DAHAB LIFE".
Suggested decision: Decide final tab set and brand; apply to all native/mobile frames.

Finding: Currency selector (EGP/USD/EUR) is designed, but FR-20.3 is Later; also shown as "EGP" in the web header.
Suggested decision: Hide for MVP or move FR-20.3 into MVP.

Finding: Host message notifications with Reply depend on in-app messaging (FR-8.1/8.2, Phase 2).
Waitlist "Claim Slot (EGP 2,400)" price ≠ activity detail price (EGP 1,650).
Weather/marine advisories need a data source and a trigger rule.
Only the Notification Center has full Arabic designs; other modules have none (except auth tablet errors).
Suggested decision: Plan an RTL QA pass for all modules.

Finding: Notification preferences for email/push per type are not designed (only WhatsApp/SMS/digest); "Manage Notification Settings" page not designed.
Language list shows 5 languages (EN, AR, FR, DE, RU); SRS MVP = EN + AR (others later, architecture-ready).
Separate "Layout & Reading Orientation" setting lets a user pick LTR while in Arabic.
Suggested decision: Tie direction to language; remove the setting.

Finding: Calendar system (Hijri) and first-day-of-week settings are not in the SRS.
Broken glyphs in the header currency pill (")▯.▯EGP(") and next to "Arabic Egypt" on the language card.
Waitlist card says "line to 60m"; the activity is 30–45 m elsewhere.
Concierge screens are not in the Figma file (only in Stitch).
Suggested decision: Copy the 8 Stitch screens into Figma page New (section "AI Concierge").

Finding: Launcher (where the guest opens the chat) is not designed on any screen.
Suggested decision: Add floating button / header icon to the shell.

Finding: Error, offline and "can't answer" states not designed.
Photo attachment & voice dictation in the input are not in the SRS.
Human escalation (FR-10.3) is Later — define fallback (WhatsApp desk link?).
Suggested decision: Show "Chat with the Dahab desk on WhatsApp" link.

Finding: Conversation history persistence across sessions not specified.

Brand name differs across the app: "DAHAB • دهب — Reservations • Touring • Trips" (auth, discovery, search, guide), "Dahab Sanctuary & Sea (Marketplace)" (bookings, reviews, favourites, settings), "DAHAB LIFE" (native notifications).
Suggested decision: Pick one brand name and lockup; update every header, footer and email template.

Finding: Tablet frames are 1280 px wide in Figma although named "834px".
Suggested decision: Resize tablet frames to 834 px so developers measure the real layout.

Finding: Several screens exist only in English; Arabic RTL is designed only for Notification Center and two auth error states.
Suggested decision: Plan an RTL design + QA pass per module before development (FR-20.1).
